regions.today: A mix of cloud and sunny spells for the rest of the day with scattered showers. Some will be heavy with a chance of isolated thunderstorms. Moderate to fresh and gusty southerly winds will decrease light to moderate.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with clear spells. Any remaining showers will die out early in the night. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 9 degrees in light to moderate southerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Largely dry on Thursday with sunny spells and just a few isolated showers during the morning and afternoon. Outbreaks of showery rain will spread from the west in the evening and may turn heavy in places. Highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees in moderate southerly winds, increasing fresh along the south coast as the afternoon wears on.
